card.title: Ready on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit by the door while we talk about trying again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Knowing I can leave is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. Please don't hand me a key yet; saying it is enough for tonight.

mechanism: A makes emotional return possible by retaining an exit and separating saying a wish from committing to it.
confusable: Unlike mere indecision, A must choose a form of vulnerability whose safety enables participation.
comparison: The door and unaccepted key shape a possible reunion, distinct from the other alternative's one-question rent discussion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
